mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.hop_ports AS hopPorts, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.route_mode AS routeMode, f.route_config AS routeConfig, f.active_tunnel_id AS activeTunnelId, f.protocol_mode AS protocolMode, f.target_health AS targetHealth, f.last_health_check AS lastHealthCheck, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.node_path AS nodePath, t.in_node_id AS inNodeId, t.out_node_id AS outNodeId, t.type, t.protocol, in_node.status AS inNodeStatus, out_node.status AS outNodeStatus FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN node in_node ON t.in_node_id = in_node.id LEFT JOIN node out_node ON t.out_node_id = out_node.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.name, f.tunnel_id AS tunnelId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.out_port AS outPort, f.hop_ports AS hopPorts, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.user_name AS userName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.strategy AS strategy, f.route_mode AS routeMode, f.route_config AS routeConfig, f.active_tunnel_id AS activeTunnelId, f.protocol_mode AS protocolMode, f.target_health AS targetHealth, f.last_health_check AS lastHealthCheck, f.inx AS inx, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, t.name AS tunnelName, t.in_ip AS inIp, t.out_ip AS outIp, t.node_path AS nodePath, t.in_node_id AS inNodeId, t.out_node_id AS outNodeId, t.type, t.protocol, in_node.status AS inNodeStatus, out_node.status AS outNodeStatus FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN node in_node ON t.in_node_id = in_node.id LEFT JOIN node out_node ON t.out_node_id = out_node.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
